# Assumption of Moses Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Monarchy, Division, and Exile

---

**3:1** And when the years of that time have been completed, then they will enter the land, and they will reign there.

**3:2** The great ones among them will become oppressors, and they will sell righteous men, and they will take possession of great estates and cast down justice.

**3:3** And they will pollute the sanctuary with their uncleanness, and they will commit fornication with it.

**3:4** And they will be corrupted, and they will defile the altar with the very offerings which they bring as gifts to the Lord.

**3:5** For they are not true priests, but slaves who have been born of slaves.

**3:6** Thus among the twelve tribes of Israel there will be a king of them who will be tender in years and who will rule for a short time.

**3:7** And two of the tribes will be torn away from the ten tribes, and three of the kings will be transferred to their own land.

**3:8** And they will build for themselves a tower, and the four of them will establish it.

**3:9** Then after that the period of their power will come to an end, for they will be led away into captivity in the east.

**3:10** Then the two tribes will make lamentation there and say: how did this come upon us, and all this misery?

**3:11** But then the Most High will remember the covenant which he made with the fathers.

**3:12** And he will reveal himself and go to them, and punish their enemies and raise them up.

**3:13** Therefore let not any tribe or nation boast over them.

**3:14** For they are the holy ones of the Lord, and are set apart for him and consecrated to him.
